payout_quote: You are eligible to receive a $50 bonus for each referral who opens a qualifying checking account (up to 10 referrals – total of $500) in a calendar year.
steps: Hold an eligible Chase personal checking account (Total Checking, Premier Plus, Sapphire Checking, or Private Client Checking) for at least ~30 days after account opening to become eligible
Generate your personalized referral link in Chase online banking/app ('Copy link')
Share your unique link with friends; the friend must apply and open a qualifying checking account through your exact link
After the friend opens the account, Chase deposits the $50 bonus into your primary checking account within 30 days
catches: Referral only counts if the friend applies via your exact personalized link — opened any other way earns nothing
Friend must open a qualifying personal checking account; the referrer must have an eligible checking account open ~30 days first
Cap: $50 per referral, up to 10 referrals per calendar year ($500 max)
Both accounts must not be closed or restricted at payout time
Bonus is taxable interest-like income (IRS 1099-INT style reporting may apply)
Employees of JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. and affiliates are not eligible
biggest_catch: You only get paid if the friend applies through your exact personalized link and opens a qualifying checking account — and you must already be a Chase checking customer of ~30 days.
eligibility: Existing Chase personal checking account holders (Total Checking, Premier Plus Checking, Sapphire Checking, Private Client Checking) enrolled ~30 days after account opening; not Chase employees
timing: $50 bonus deposited to your primary checking account within 30 days after each referred friend opens a qualifying account
